prose: The Financial Times interviews David Silver - the AlphaGo architect who left DeepMind - about Ineffable, his startup building an AI 'super learner' through reinforcement learning as an alternative path to LLMs: machines that teach themselves. Basis: the FT article is paywalled and no body text was retrievable, so this summary reflects the interview's stated subject rather than its content.
highlights: Ex-DeepMind AlphaGo architect David Silver's startup Ineffable builds an RL 'super learner'.
Framed as an alternative path to LLMs - machines that teach themselves.
Basis: FT paywall - only the interview's stated subject was retrievable.
